initialExam.title: CSIR NET 2026 (Council of Scientific & Industrial Research)
initialExam.conductingBody: National Testing Agency (on behalf of CSIR)
initialExam.description: CSIR NET determines eligibility for JRF (Junior Research Fellowship) and Lectureship in Indian universities and colleges in the fields of Life Sciences, Physical Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Mathematical Sciences, and Earth Sciences.
initialExam.eligibility: M.Sc or equivalent in relevant science subject with 55% marks
initialExam.syllabus: Part A: General Science, Quantitative Reasoning, Research Aptitude. Part B: Subject-specific (Life/Physical/Chemical/Mathematical/Earth Sciences). Part C: Higher-level subject questions.
initialExam.examPattern: Single paper: 200 marks, 3 hours. Part A: 30 marks, Part B: 70 marks, Part C: 100 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Single CBT → Merit-based JRF or Lectureship eligibility
initialExam.jobRole: Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Assistant Professor/Lecturer in universities
initialExam.careerGrowth: JRF → SRF → Post-Doc → Scientist. Lectureship: Assistant Professor → Associate Professor → Professor.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit csirnet.nta.nic.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit

salaryRange.description: JRF: ₹31,000/month + HRA. Lectureship: As per UGC pay scales

initialExam.perks: JRF: Fellowship + Contingency grant. Lectureship: UGC pay scales, DA, Medical
